programmes.d: Blue wants to show us something she's been trying to do, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is.
We help Steve and Blue fix their broken toy plane. There's something else to fix, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is.
We are having a big art show and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue is making for the show.
We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do. Throughout the day, with the help of our scale friends, we compare the weight of objects and determine which are heavy and which are light.

We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to go. Using a map, we help Shovel and Pail figure out which buildings would be best suited for specific errands then we decide what form of transportation would work best.

Blue hears something that we can't hear, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is. Led by our ears, we help Shovel and Pail follow the path a gopher took in the woods, based on the sounds he makes.
Guided by signs and symbols around the house, we play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to have her snack.
Steve and Blue are playing Hide and Seek and it's Blue's turn to hide. We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to hide.
We play Blue's Clues to figure out what animal Blue wants to learn about. Throughout the episode, we learn about different animal behaviors by observing them and pretending to be them.

All of our friends are pretending to be different occupations. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to be. We help Steve, who is pretending to be a reporter, figure out what occupations our various friends are.
Steve discovers his heartbeat with a stethoscope -- and Blue has discovered something too. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue has discovered.

Oh no! It's a hot summer day and Blue and Steve are composing a list of friends to invite to our pool party, but there's someone we forgot to invite! We play Blue's Clues to figure out who's missing from our list.

We spend the entire episode outdoors enjoying nature and playing Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to play. We identify herbs and help Mr. Salt and Paprika put together a bouquet, go on a walk, and play "I Spy."
We're playing Blues Clues because we want to know what Blue invented. Steve wants to invent something, too, but he keeps inventing things that already exist!
Something kind of silly's going on at Steve and Blue's house and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what makes Blue laugh.
Steve and Blue are going on a big trip! We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to go. As we search for clues, we pack for our trip and learn about new environments.
It's Blue's costume party and lots of silly spooky things are happening! Magenta doesn't have a costume, so we play Blue's Clues to help her figure out what to wear.

It's a special nighttime game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do tonight. As we search for clues we join Shovel and Pail for a game and learn about the animals who are awake while we are asleep.

Blue is feeling shy, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what she is feeling shy about. Along the way, we meet Pail's friend Sifter and Miranda, who lives with Magenta. We help Shovel figure out how to play with Sifter.
Magenta Gets Glasses: It's a big day -- Magenta is getting glasses! We launch into a game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Magenta will be able to do when she gets her glasses.
Imagine Nation: With a shape made out of two chairs and a blanket, Steve is imagining there's an igloo in the living room! But Blue sees something different.
The Anything Box: Steve and Blue found an empty box in the backyard. They figure out that if we imagine, we can use the box to play rocket ship. We blast off -- and play Blue's Clues.
Adventure!: Sir Steve-a-lot and Queen Blue must rescue King Horace from Periwinkle, the castle keeper! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what we should imagine ourselves to be.
Superfriends!: It's a bird, it's a plane -- it's the Blue's Clues Superheroes! Steve, Blue, Tickety and Slippery are all being superheroes today.

The Baby's Here! (aka Blues Big News): Anticipation builds as we wait for Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper to call from the hospital to tell us that the new baby's here! And what should we give the baby? Blue knows!
Blue's New Place: Blue decides to create a special space for herself in the bedroom. What's going to be her favorite thing to do in her special space? We play Blue's Clues to figure it out.
What's Inside?: Steve and Blue discover a locked trunk inside their bedroom closet. What could be inside? We play Blue's Clues to figure out where the key is so we can open the trunk.
Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper Day: Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper do so much for us that Blue and Steve create an impromptu holiday to celebrate them both -- "Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper Day."
What's New, Blue?: Steve and Blue are inspired to create a newspaper to tell everyone what's new around the house. Ee play Blue's Clues to help Steve search for news.
Bugs!: To the untamed wilderness of our backyard we go! Join Steve and Blue on a bug-watching expedition and help to play Blue's Clues as we figure out what Blue's favorite bug is.
¡Un Día Con Plum!: A visit from Plum gets us learning new Spanish words. Meanwhile, we play Blue's Clues to figure out what kind of marioneta Blue thinks Plum and Periwinkle should make.
Making Changes: The arrival of a new baby in the house means making some adjustments. We play Blue's Clues to figure out an additional way to assist Salt and Pepper in taking care of Cinnamon
Something To Do Blue: Blue can't decide what to do today. Mr. Salt encourages us to pick a few items from around the house and use our imaginations to invent something new to do with them.
Blue's Book Nook: Blue is organizing the books in her book nook. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to read about.
Let's Boogie: Steve's got sneakers on today and that makes him feel like dancing! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to make a dance about.
Blocks: Blue's friend Green is over today and we're playing with blocks. Steve is making a playground for his cow figurines and Blue is building a really tall tower.
Hop on board our cardboard bus and help Steve pick up our friends for a day of pretend school, where Blue is the teacher! We play Blue's Clues to figure out where we'll be going.
Rhyme Time: If you've got a rhyme, we've got the time today, Steve is a poet and he knows it - and so are we! We play Blues Clues to figure out what Blue wants to rhyme about.
Blue's Backyard Ballgame Bonanza: If it's round and rolls, there's a good chance it belongs in Blue's Backyard Ballgame Bonanza. We're inventing all sorts of new ballgames today.
Today we're using charts to measure all sorts of things. Mr. Salt needs to figure out what everyone's favorite snack is so he can make them, so we make a chart to help him out!
Today we're painting portraits of our friends. We play Blue's Clues to figure out who else Blue wants to add to our Portrait of Pals.
Joe and Blue are playing Shape Searchers and they need our help. Blue pulls various shapes out of her bag and we look around and find things with the same shape!

It's time to clean up because a special guest is coming over to visit! But who is it? We play Blue's Clues to figure out who our surprise guest is. While searching for clues, we straighten up the house.
We're making contraptions! Joe demonstrates his amazing "Crayon Slide" for us. Blue is making a contraption, too, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it's going to do.
Everyone is making up games today! Joe's made-up game is called Presto Change-Joe! Joe changes something about his appearance and we try to figure out what's different.
Who's got rhythm? We all do! All of our friends are making music! What instrument is Blue going to play in Blue's Big Band?
Today we're playing store! Our friends have set up pretend stores and preschoolers help Joe shop for everything on his is. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to get at the store.

Perwinkle and Blue found a bird's egg in a nest in the backyard! It's not quite ready to hatch, so we need to be patient and wait. While we wait we play Blue's Clues to figure out what to do to pass the time.

Shh! It's Joe's birthday and everyone's planning a surprise party! The characters in the house need our help to get things ready - but something is missing. Let's play Blue's Clues to figure out what else we need to do.
